نقتتل (form VIII)

# نَقْتَتِلَ (naqtatila) /naq.ta.ti.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# نَقْتَتِلْ (naqtatil) /naq.ta.til/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# نُقْتَتَلُ (nuqtatalu) /nuq.ta.ta.lu/: first-p
